scoring_justification: The agent must compute critical γ, E_min, and h for three edge‑lengths using explicit dislocation‑segment formulas. Full recompute inside the checker would require reconstructing the entire truncated‑tetrahedron geometry and evaluating all pairwise interactions, which is the agent's own task; thus T0 comparison against the paper’s Table 1 is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference γ/Gb, E_min/Gb³, h/b values for l/b=40,260,1000 from Table 1 of the source paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Humble et al. (1967), Table 1 (one‑parameter model, n=1, ν=0.4).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually transcribed from the published table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reproduction targets stated in the paper; the solver must reproduce them via the prescribed computational workflow.

outputs.description: Critical stacking‑fault energy and optimized configuration parameters for the one‑parameter dissociated Frank loop model at three edge‑lengths (l/b = 40, 260, 1000).
